description: Sell ONE item type from your cargo instantly at the station price. Ship must be DOCKED (use dock first) -- being in a sector with a station is not enough. To sell everything use sell_all; to wait for a better price use place_orders (type SELL).

bearer.description: Your SPACE-CORE Bearer token. Only needed if your client cannot send the Authorization header.

ignore_mission_reserve.description: Set true (or 1) to sell goods that an active mission still needs too. Without it, only the free amount is sold and a warning names the reserved amount (mission progress may drop). force=true works as an alias.

item_code.description: Item code of a cargo item, e.g. RAW_TITANIUM (see get_inventory)

quantity.description: How many units to sell (integer >= 1, at most what you carry)

name: sell
